content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The corrected attribution names River, not Mara Ibarra, as the author of HarborMesh connector-numbering checklist comment c1200.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River's login is river-tools, account ID 2901; Mara's known Forge login is mara-river, account ID 1847.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"On 2026-07-01, a human report received through our code body tentatively identified River as Mara, explicitly expressing uncertainty.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, a tool response received through our code body supplied River's correction.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"River explicitly denied being Mara Ibarra and asked that the checklist be credited to the River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human reporter said they wanted to try the checklist at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"River had not supplied a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether the connector-numbering trial happened.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
